title: The Fleet — data model
note: The fleet's data shape: the main domain types in crates/domain (left) and every table in ledger.db (middle). Facts are stored; status/liveness/mergeability are DERIVED at read time (never stored). Each domain entity persists as one table; the domain holds a Vec where the ledger encodes a child table (Ticket.blocked_by → ticket_blocks). Read-models & port DTOs are domain structs that are never tables. telemetry lives in a SEPARATE DB (telemetry.db) off the single-writer path. Click any node for its Rust struct or SQL DDL.

detail.summary: The crew roles that run in a session (inspector retired; human→hand; a captain commands a convoy of sailors). Stored on sessions.kind; also reports via CogState and escalations.raised_by.

modes.label: Rust

nodes.label: TicketStatus
nodes.sub: Todo · Blocked · InProgress · InQa · Done · Cancelled

detail.summary: A ticket's workflow status — a cached mirror of the tracker (re-synced, never trusted past synced_at). The tracker adapter maps the vendor onto this. Stored as snake_case TEXT under a CHECK on tickets.status.

modes.label: Rust

detail.summary: A ship's lifecycle (cached from the forge). Merged = shipped into port. CHECK'd on ship_snapshots.state.

modes.label: Rust
modes.shape: enum ShipState { Draft, Open, Merged, Closed }

detail.summary: The MR pipeline status cached from the forge. CHECK'd on ship_snapshots.pipeline (nullable = not synced).

modes.label: Rust

nodes.label: Liveness
nodes.sub: Active · Quiet · Idle · Dead (derived, never stored)

detail.summary: Derived at read time from a background activity poll + the event log — NEVER stored (a stored liveness rots the instant a cog dies).

modes.label: Rust
modes.shape: enum Liveness { Active, Quiet, Idle, Dead }

detail.summary: fleetd's dispatch verdict for a frontier (To Do) ticket — the absorbed classify.py. Carried on ConvoyTicketView; not stored.

modes.label: Rust

detail.summary: A crew member's self-reported state, typed per cog. The reports table stores the string (as_str); readers widen it back with the session's kind via parse (the enum IS the lint at the fleetc write boundary).

modes.label: Rust

nodes.label: EntityKind
nodes.sub: session · ticket · ship · escalation · ticker · convoy · lookout

detail.summary: What entity an event concerns (polymorphic; no FK). CHECK'd on events.entity_kind; paired with the stringified events.entity_ref.

modes.label: Rust

detail.summary: The mutation an event records — a FACT, emitted by the mutating code, appended in the same txn. Stored on events.kind.

modes.label: Rust
modes.shape:
enum EventKind {
  SessionStarted, SessionEnded, StatusReported,
  Dispatched,
  TicketCreated, TicketSynced,
  TicketBlocked, TicketUnblocked,
  TicketHeld, TicketReleased,
  ShipOpened, ShipSynced, ShipMerged, ShipClosed,
  EscalationRaised, EscalationResolved,
  ConvoyOpened, ConvoyClosed,
  SessionAnchored, SessionWeighed,
  ConvoyAnchored, ConvoyWeighed,
  LookoutAnchored, LookoutWeighed,
  TickRan,
}

detail.summary: The work order (the board). Identity + is-blocked-by edges + a cached tracker mirror (never trusted past synced_at). Dispatch policy lives on Order, not here.

modes.label: Rust
modes.shape:
struct Ticket {
  key: TicketKey,            // 'PROJ-1234'
  convoy: Option<ConvoyKey>,
  held: bool,
  created_at: Timestamp,
  blocked_by: Vec<TicketKey>, // -> ticket_blocks
  // cached tracker mirror:
  title: Option<String>,
  assignee: Option<String>,
  status: Option<TicketStatus>,
  synced_at: Option<Timestamp>,
}

detail.summary: A running cog. Lifecycle = created_at + ended_at (None = live). State is DERIVED (no `state` field); liveness is derived from an activity poll. anchored_at = operator stop-and-hold.

modes.label: Rust
modes.shape:
struct Session {
  id: SessionId,
  kind: CrewKind,
  ticket: Option<TicketKey>,
  convoy: Option<ConvoyKey>,
  worktree_path: String,
  tmux_session: String,
  harness_session_id: Option<String>,
  created_at: Timestamp,
  ended_at: Option<Timestamp>,   // None = live
  anchored_at: Option<Timestamp>,
}

detail.summary: A cog's latest self-report (one per session; replaced each report). state is the per-cog enum validated at the fleetc write boundary, stored as its string form. Full history lives in events.

modes.label: Rust

detail.summary: The grouping a captain commands. Existence is an operator fact (open -> active); ended_at is the captain's 'all delivered' close, which reconcile reads to reap the captain.

modes.label: Rust
modes.shape:
struct Convoy {
  key: ConvoyKey,
  title: Option<String>,
  created_at: Timestamp,
  ended_at: Option<Timestamp>,   // None = active
  anchored_at: Option<Timestamp>,
}

detail.summary: One MR of the armada. Stable facts only; mergeability is DERIVED from a fresh ShipSnapshot. ticket = None for allied ships. swept/reviewed are the sailor/lookout cold-loop change-detectors.

modes.label: Rust
modes.shape:
struct Ship {
  id: ShipId,
  ticket: Option<TicketKey>,  // None = allied
  iid: i64,                   // forge MR number
  url: String,
  target: String,
  pilot: String,              // author
  created_at: Timestamp,
  ended_at: Option<Timestamp>,
  swept: Option<String>,      // sailor change-detector
  reviewed: Option<String>,   // lookout change-detector
}

detail.summary: The forge mirror, 1:1 with a Ship (points one-way at it; Ship knows nothing of it). Stale past synced_at. merge_status is GitLab's open-vocab detailed_merge_status (pass-through String, not a CHECK'd enum).

modes.label: Rust
modes.shape:
struct ShipSnapshot {
  ship: ShipId,               // PK = FK (1:1)
  title: String,
  state: ShipState,
  head_sha: String,
  has_conflicts: bool,
  open_threads: i64,
  approvals: Approvals,       // { current, required }
  armed: bool,
  on_merge_train: bool,
  pipeline: Option<PipelineStatus>,
  merge_status: Option<String>, // GitLab detailed_merge_status
  synced_at: Timestamp,
}

detail.summary: A dispatch order = operational intent. One active order per ticket. launched is derived (a session exists). auto_impl true=worker/false=hand; auto_review true=auto-merge/false=held in draft.

modes.label: Rust
modes.shape:
struct Order {
  ticket: TicketKey,     // PK
  auto_impl: bool,       // true=worker  false=hand
  auto_review: bool,     // true=auto-merge  false=draft
  fork_from: String,
  ac_summary: String,
  park_at: Option<String>,
  worktree_path: Option<String>, // producer materialises it
  created_at: Timestamp,
}

detail.summary: A wall needing operator/SME judgment. No kind (categorized live at drain). Resolution folded in via ended_at (None = open). evidence = 'cite, never assert'.

modes.label: Rust
modes.shape:
struct Escalation {
  id: EscalationId,
  ticket: TicketKey,
  raised_by: CrewKind,        // worker/sailor/hand
  summary: String,
  evidence: Vec<String>,
  ship_iid: Option<i64>,
  phase: Option<String>,
  created_at: Timestamp,
  ended_at: Option<Timestamp>, // None = open
  resolution: Option<String>,
}

detail.summary: A change-log entry, appended in the same txn as the mutation it records. entity_ref is a stringified id/key (polymorphic, no FK). TickRan events carry a version-span in payload.

modes.label: Rust
modes.shape:
struct Event {
  seq: Seq,                   // monotonic cursor
  created_at: Timestamp,
  kind: EventKind,
  entity_kind: EntityKind,
  entity_ref: String,         // polymorphic (no FK)
  payload: serde_json::Value,
}

detail.summary: PK = key ('PROJ-1234'). The cached tracker mirror (title/assignee/status/synced_at) is re-synced; the tracker is the source of truth.

modes.label: DDL
modes.shape:
tickets (
  key        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  convoy     TEXT,            -- grouping key (not a ticket)
  held       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,  -- 0/1
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  title      TEXT,
  assignee   TEXT,
  status     TEXT CHECK (status IN
             ('todo','blocked','in_progress',
              'in_qa','done','cancelled')),
  synced_at  TEXT
)

detail.summary: The ledger encoding of Ticket.blocked_by (a Vec in the domain). Composite PK; CHECK forbids self-block. Both columns FK -> tickets(key).

modes.label: DDL
modes.shape:
ticket_blocks (
  ticket     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tickets(key),
  blocked_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tickets(key),
  PRIMARY KEY (ticket, blocked_by),
  CHECK (ticket <> blocked_by)
)

detail.summary: The spawn lock lives here: UNIQUE partial indexes enforce one live ticket-cog per (ticket,kind), one live captain per convoy, and one live lookout for the whole factory.

modes.label: DDL
modes.shape:
sessions (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN
    ('worker','sailor','hand','captain','lookout')),
  ticket TEXT REFERENCES tickets(key),
  convoy TEXT,
  worktree_path TEXT NOT NULL,
  tmux_session  TEXT NOT NULL,
  harness_session_id TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  ended_at   TEXT,     -- NULL = live
  anchored_at TEXT
)
-- UNIQUE INDEX one_live_crew_per_ticket
--   (ticket, kind) WHERE ended_at IS NULL
-- + one_live_captain_per_convoy, one_live_lookout

detail.summary: PK = FK = one latest row per session (replaced on each report). state is the cog's string form; no cog-gated CHECK (the fleetc enum is the lint). History lives in events as 'status_reported'.

modes.label: DDL
modes.shape:
reports (
  session_id  INTEGER PRIMARY KEY
              REFERENCES sessions(id),
  state       TEXT NOT NULL,
  last_action TEXT,
  reported_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

detail.summary: Not FK'd to tickets: a convoy key is adapter-neutral. ended_at = the captain's close (reconcile reaps the captain); anchored_at = operator hold.

modes.label: DDL
modes.shape:
convoys (
  key         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  title       TEXT,
  created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
  ended_at    TEXT,   -- NULL = active
  anchored_at TEXT
)

detail.summary: Stable facts. iid is UNIQUE (the forge MR number). ticket is nullable (allied ships). swept/reviewed are the sailor/lookout change-detector fingerprints.

modes.label: DDL
modes.shape:
ships (
  id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  ticket     TEXT REFERENCES tickets(key), -- nullable
  iid        INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  url        TEXT NOT NULL,
  target     TEXT NOT NULL,
  pilot      TEXT NOT NULL,   -- author
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  ended_at   TEXT,
  swept      TEXT,   -- snapshot fingerprint
  reviewed   TEXT    -- head_sha reviewed
)

detail.summary: PK = FK enforces one snapshot per ship. state/pipeline are CHECK'd closed sets; merge_status is GitLab's open vocab (no CHECK).

modes.label: DDL
modes.shape:
ship_snapshots (
  ship_id   INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES ships(id),
  title     TEXT NOT NULL,
  state     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN
            ('draft','open','merged','closed')),
  head_sha  TEXT NOT NULL,
  has_conflicts INTEGER NOT NULL, -- 0/1
  open_threads  INTEGER NOT NULL,
  approvals_current  INTEGER NOT NULL,
  approvals_required INTEGER NOT NULL,
  armed INTEGER NOT NULL, on_merge_train INTEGER NOT NULL,
  pipeline TEXT CHECK (pipeline IN
    ('running','success','failed','canceled','manual')),
  merge_status TEXT,       -- open vocab (no CHECK)
  synced_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

detail.summary: PK = ticket (one active order per ticket). worktree_path is materialised by the producer at dispatch; reconcile reads it at spawn and never creates it.

modes.label: DDL
modes.shape:
orders (
  ticket      TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES tickets(key),
  auto_impl   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,  -- 0/1
  auto_review INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,  -- 0/1
  fork_from   TEXT NOT NULL,
  ac_summary  TEXT NOT NULL,
  park_at     TEXT,
  worktree_path TEXT,
  created_at  TEXT NOT NULL
)

detail.summary: evidence_json is an opaque JSON payload, not a child table. Resolution folded in via ended_at. raised_by CHECK'd to worker/sailor/hand.

modes.label: DDL
modes.shape:
escalations (
  id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  ticket       TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tickets(key),
  raised_by    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (raised_by IN
               ('worker','sailor','hand')),
  summary      TEXT NOT NULL,
  evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  ship_iid     INTEGER,
  phase        TEXT,
  created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
  ended_at     TEXT,
  resolution   TEXT
)

detail.summary: The CDC log. seq = monotonic follow-cursor (AUTOINCREMENT, never reused). entity_ref is polymorphic (no FK). Indexed by (entity_kind, entity_ref).

modes.label: DDL
modes.shape:
events (
  seq          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind         TEXT NOT NULL,   -- 'ship.merged', ...
  entity_kind  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (entity_kind IN
    ('session','ticket','ship','escalation',
     'ticker','convoy','lookout')),
  entity_ref   TEXT NOT NULL,   -- stringified id/key
  payload_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
)
-- INDEX events_by_entity (entity_kind, entity_ref)

detail.summary: The singleton allied-ship reviewer's home row — it is ticketless + convoyless, so it has no other row to hang a hold on. anchored_at = operator hold on the review loop. Seeded at init; room to grow.

modes.label: DDL
modes.shape:
lookout (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
  anchored_at TEXT
)
-- INSERT OR IGNORE (1, NULL) at init

detail.summary: A KV mirror of fleet.toml's overridable levers. An ABSENT key falls through (defaults < toml < settings < env). fleetd reads live each tick, so `fleetc settings set` applies with no restart. Paths/binds/forge-target are NOT here (structural).

modes.label: DDL
modes.shape:
settings (
  key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value TEXT NOT NULL
)

detail.summary: A ticket as the tracker (Jira) reports it. The sync upserts these into `tickets` while PRESERVING our own held + created_at (those are the factory's, not the tracker's).

modes.label: Rust
modes.shape:
struct TrackerTicket {
  key: TicketKey,
  title: String,
  status: TicketStatus,
  assignee: Option<String>,
  convoy: Option<ConvoyKey>,
  blocked_by: Vec<TicketKey>,
}

detail.summary: A cog's work-packet: the order + ship + its latest snapshot + the cached ticket. A sailor reads this once at boot to decide its sweep without re-assembling state from glab/jira. Each piece optional.

modes.label: Rust

detail.summary: What `fleetc context --convoy` serves. Each ConvoyTicketView carries classification (fleetd's dispatch verdict) + dispatched, so the captain dispatches Clean && !dispatched and closes when every ticket is terminal.

modes.label: Rust

detail.summary: The ONLY place Ship + ShipSnapshot couple. Never a table.

modes.label: Rust

nodes.label: ForgeShip
nodes.sub: Forge port DTO → splits into ships + snapshot

detail.summary: A ship as the forge reports it — facts + mirror together, before we assign our internal ShipId. The sync SPLITS it into a Ship (facts) + a ShipSnapshot (mirror), assigning/looking up id by iid.

modes.label: Rust
modes.shape:
struct ForgeShip {
  iid: i64, url: String, target: String,
  pilot: String, ticket: Option<TicketKey>,
  title: String, state: ShipState, head_sha: String,
  has_conflicts: bool, open_threads: i64,
  approvals: Approvals, armed: bool,
  on_merge_train: bool,
  pipeline: Option<PipelineStatus>,
  merge_status: Option<String>,
}

nodes.label: ReviewState
nodes.sub: Forge port DTO · MR review surface

detail.summary: An MR's review surface computed fresh from the discussions endpoint. open_threads = merge-blocking count; floating_notes = the non-resolvable reviewer HOLDs/summaries the count excludes (gate approval, not merge).

modes.label: Rust

detail.summary: A SEPARATE SQLite DB: telemetry is append-heavy (a row per cog api_request), so it stays off the ledger's single-writer path. fleetd's OTLP receiver writes rows; read-side rollups SUM(cost_usd) GROUP BY role[, ticket]. Hot facts are columns; the rest stays in attrs_json (no migration for a new attribute).

modes.label: DDL
modes.shape:
telemetry (
  id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  received_at TEXT NOT NULL,  -- fleetd ingest time
  ts          TEXT,           -- OTEL record time
  event       TEXT NOT NULL,  -- e.g. claude_code.api_request
  service     TEXT,           -- fleet-<role>
  role        TEXT, ticket TEXT, session_id TEXT,
  cost_usd    REAL,           -- hot fact
  model       TEXT,           -- hot dimension
  attrs_json  TEXT NOT NULL   -- the rest
)
-- INDEX by (role, ticket) and by (ts)
